name: localman-next
description: Localman suite: mock API, web API client, Tunelo, MCP and DevOps toolkit

scripts.lint: biome check . && pnpm check:i18n && pnpm check:tokens && pnpm check:brand && pnpm check:tunelo-boundary
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 typecheck && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.check:brand: check-brand --config brand.config.json --dir apps --dir packages --skip-dir portal-dist --skip-dir dist-native --skip-dir android --skip-dir ios --ignore-path apps/web/public --source-file '\.(ts|tsx|js|mjs|cjs)$' --code-file '\.(ts|tsx|js|mjs|cjs)$' --test-file '\.test\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$|/__tests__/|/testing/|/test-support/' --hint 'read brand.appName from @achoo254/brand'
